packed_sprite_slots: 3:25 at 0x430170 pops four words and calls 0x456540. Resolver masks tag 0x0F000000, index low 16 bits and group bits 20..23. Tag 0x02000000 maps button index + 0x90 + (group << 7). Portable adapter resolves the button sprite, not the native array index.
font_effect_capability: PAL.dll 0x100AB4C0 stores the low 16 effect bits at font state+0x1E0. PalFontDrawText 0x100AB0A0 forwards the effect into 0x100AAB50. That routine accepts effect 0..3 at 0x100AAF41 and dispatches four kernels via 0x100AB08C. The host Reference font profile enables effect 3 without enabling multilingual or registered VM semantics. No new native export prototype is declared by this capability selection.
